title: Slushie Bar Xtra Pom Peach Punch 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Xtra Pom Peach Punch blends the vibrant sweetness of ripe Peach with the sharp tang of Pomegranate for a perfectly balanced fruit vape that’s bursting with flavour. The delicate yet juicy Peach flavour combines with the tart bite of Pomegranate to deliver a unique and satisfying vaping experience that’s ideal for vapers who enjoy bold, fruity blends with a touch of sweetness. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Slushie Bar Xtra Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Each e-liquid in the collection provides smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for those seeking a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids are perfect for all-day vaping with a flavour-packed experience waiting in every puff.
